summary: Add Git change metadata and atomic ref transaction primitives

replay.detail: No daemon state, replay, or checkpoint changes.

schema.detail: Defines the v1 Git change.json metadata commit and refs/st/changes/v1 namespace in a library. No database DDL, claim kind, or binding-contract extension.

rules.detail: Defines legal library publication edges, terminal fencing and explicit worker/nonce release. No stage authority, main protection, curator, or merge queue changes.

compatibility.detail: No existing CLI or client protocol changes. Indexed reads, runtime authority adapters, PR mirroring, and user-facing change commands are later slices.

manual.detail: The library is not an activated workflow. No operator action or production pruning is required by this slice.

recovery.detail: Transport callers must reconcile uncertain pushes by exact metadata object and nonce before claiming ownership. Missing/conflicting owned Change-Id trailers fail validation; explicit external import preserves its source commit. No automated namespace repair or claim takeover is activated.
